proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C _ h ha
  have s := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := B) (p₂ := C) (p₃ := A) h
  have c := EuclideanGeometry.cos_angle_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := B) (p₂ := C) (p₃ := A) h
  rw [ha, Real.sin_pi_div_six, dist_comm B A] at s
  rw [ha, Real.cos_pi_div_six, dist_comm B A] at c
  constructor
  · linarith
  · rw [← c, ← s]; ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A = Real.pi / 2 → EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B = Real.pi / 6 → dist A B = 2 * dist B C ∧ dist A C = Real.sqrt 3 * dist B C
